shortBulletSummary: Fed minutes hint at more rate hikes. Nearly all Federal Reserve officials believe further interest rate increases may be needed, reinforcing expectations of a December hike.
US spot Bitcoin ETFs continue to see significant net outflows, with cumulative November outflows nearing $2.6 billion.
Spot Ethereum ETFs recorded $131M in net outflows on Nov 19, marking the fifth straight day of withdrawals.
Bitcoin fell below $63,000, while Ethereum reached its lowest daily value since early July, with extreme fear in the market.
Rising Middle East tensions contributed to a broad sell-off across traditional safe havens and risk assets, including Bitcoin.
